snippet.title: Arcade Game: Grobda (1984 Namco)
snippet.description:
A maze/shooting 'em up game where control a tank and destroying enemy tanks that attack in waves and they must be destroyed before they do the same to you.

One of the tanks shown here is one of the enemies in Xevious. The player tank you control is named Grobda. 

Note: No Cheats Used. Only savestates used. Great tank game from Namco.
